screen_hazard.statistics:
Log-rank test, one row per biomarker: 12 of 12 computed. The adjusted p-values are adjusted by Benjamini-Hochberg across the 12 biomarkers that have a p-value.

R’s note: Each row's estimate: Hazard ratio, High / Low.

R’s note: p_value is adjusted across the 12 rows that have a p-value by p.adjust(method = 'BH'); 0 of the 12 rows have none and are left out of the adjustment.

R’s note: An event is a row where censor is 0; the others are censored.

R’s note: High and low are the two sides of each biomarker's median among the rows used; a value on the median is low. The p-values are the log-rank test's and the intervals are the Cox model's.

200 participants are in the frame. A row is of the ones who have its biomarker, so each row has its own counts.
